Cube Basher

This project now runs through a React shell while the original Three.js gameplay stays intact in a preserved legacy runtime.

Current Migration Stage

React owns the app frame and startup flow. The original gameplay, graphics, audio, save system, and combat loop still run from the legacy game entry so we do not break the playable build.

Why This Structure

The safest path is to migrate menus, HUD, and state boundaries into React first, then extract gameplay systems from the legacy file in smaller passes.

Next Steps

  • Replace legacy menus with React screens.
  • Extract save, audio, and game config into modules.
  • Mount Three.js directly from a React game canvas component.
